fact: The World Bank project document says a management information system and a beneficiary registry of over 1.2 million households are in place at INAS, though the MIS needs modernization.
The World Bank Additional Financing of US$154.4 million will finance modernization of the core INAS Management Information System for performance, interoperability, data quality and analytics.
The World Bank says the project contributes to a government milestone of full operation of e-INAS, the National Social Protection Institute's system.
The World Bank says the PSSB Child Grant target is set on beneficiaries fully registered on eINAS by January 2025.

The World Bank says INAS contracts payment service providers (M-Pesa, Emola, Mkesh) centrally since 2024, about 136,000 digital accounts were opened by May 2025, and Child Grant payments started in March 2025.
